question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given below to fill in the blank in the following sentence.

Adversity

The sage said, “One should keep patience during _______”.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Hardships**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word '**Adversity**' refers to a state of difficulties or misfortune. (विपत्ति)

 
 
• **Example**: Many people show their true character in times of **adversity**.
 
 
 
• The correct synonym, '**Hardships**', means severe suffering or deprivation. (कठिनाई)
 
 
• **Example**: People in war-torn areas often have to endure many **hardships**.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct synonym for '**Adversity**' is '**Hardships**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is- “**Option 4**”.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• '**Good times**' refers to a state or period of prosperity or happiness. (अच्छे समय)
 
• '**Tribute**' is a gift, compliment, or praise given to someone as a token of respect or admiration. (श्रद्धांजलि)
 
• '**Challenges**' mean a demanding task or situation that requires a person's full effort and skills. (चुनौतियाँ)
